prompt: Looking straight down from 120 metres over the car import lot at Royal Portbury Dock: thousands of identical new cars in tight rows on grey tarmac under orange floodlights. The bottom half of the lot already has its headlights on, a field of white; the top half is still dark. Four tiny figures stand frozen beside a security hut at the edge. 24mm aerial. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
